title: [Main]-Exporting vendor remittance gets stuck when a payment jour nal is sorted by Document No.
summary: Fixed vendor remittance export hanging when a payment journal is sorted by Document No. The export now uses primary key order instead of the current sort order to prevent lines from being processed repeatedly.
key_points: Export loop now uses primary key order (Journal Template Name, Journal Batch Name, Line No.) instead of the journal's current sort order
Prevents lines from resorting during processing when Document No. is updated
Each line is now exported exactly once instead of repeatedly
